games.title: SquadSlice
games.mechanic: Guess a club from a season-specific squad nationality pie chart.
games.requiredData: squad nationality counts, seasons, club artwork
games.notes: Verified daily season squad and nationality chart, source-specific seeded reveal order, Random or Clockwise whole-country 30/60/full reveals, three guesses, club shirt search, final squad portraits and saved rounds.

games.title: Statdle
games.mechanic: Identify a season-specific player through revealed stats.
games.requiredData: season appearances, goals, assists, club, nation, position, value
games.notes: Native daily historical-season clues, five chances, two random reveals per miss/skip, Normal and Hard with club/nation locked, saved attempts and single-win streak credit.

games.title: Top 10
games.mechanic: Name ten players on a scoped statistical ranking.
games.requiredData: ranked lists with values and cutoff dates
games.notes: Native untimed Top 10 consumes the verified dated package. Nationality flags, ranked portrait reveals, source scope, hints, mistake tracking, persistent completion and idempotent streak credit. Timer variant remains optional.

games.title: Grid
games.mechanic: Place distinct players at the intersection of two categories.

games.title: Bingo
games.mechanic: Place offered players into twelve matching categories.

games.title: Goltexto
games.mechanic: Find a player through trait-based similarity feedback.
games.requiredData: scoped player profiles and explicit similarity weights
games.notes: Verified daily source selection, exact trait scoring, signed visual feedback, 10/20/100 guesses, keyboard-safe profile search, saved rounds and one-time win credit. Catalog traits retain source scope; they are not current football affiliations.

games.title: Impostor
games.mechanic: Select all players that satisfy a category, avoiding outsiders.
games.requiredData: complete round-specific positive and negative membership
games.notes: Country-based native boards use four explicit seed categories and exclude ambiguous cross-country membership within each board. Other source categories and authored daily variants remain to be added.

games.title: Pyramid
games.mechanic: Rank ten offered players from highest to lowest across four pyramid rows.
games.requiredData: ranked values with tied-score rules and cutoff dates
games.notes: Verified daily player/value pairs, source floor-day selection and tie handling; draggable or tap-swapped portraits, Easy bands, one correct-slot check, exact-rank grading and saved rounds.

games.title: Connections
games.mechanic: Partition sixteen players into four hidden groups.
games.requiredData: authored four-player groups and ambiguity rules
games.notes: Country-based native boards use four explicit seed categories and exclude ambiguous cross-country membership within each board. Other source categories and authored daily variants remain to be added.

games.title: Clubs XI
games.mechanic: Build an XI from eleven different clubs.
games.notes: Archived mode-specific membership and position pools; five formations, saved XI, Undo and assisted connections. Source roster cutoff is unpublished.

games.title: Legacy
games.mechanic: Identify a player from four unordered career clubs.
games.notes: Native daily four-club mystery with source kit artwork, one reveal per miss/skip, source-shuffled nonchronological order, saved rounds and single-win streak credit.

games.title: Bingo Retro
games.requiredData: separate source legend catalog, explicit historical memberships and daily category recipe
games.notes: Native verified daily 3×4 board with 251 source-listed legends, random offers, skip assistance after 5–12 skips, repeated players permitted, untimed/60s/90s options, saved deadlines and one-time completed-win credit.

games.title: Retro XI
games.mechanic: Build an XI from eleven different historical season squads.
games.notes: Archived mode-specific membership and position pools; five formations, saved XI, Undo and assisted connections. Source roster cutoff is unpublished. One season squad per distinct club.

games.title: Link
games.mechanic: Identify a player from five former senior teammates.
games.requiredData: verified shared senior appearances, not merely squad overlap
games.notes: Native daily five-teammate mystery using explicit source-authored senior connections and general player identities, source-shuffled portrait clues, saved rounds and single-win streak credit.

games.title: Wordle
games.mechanic: Guess a football name using letter position feedback.
games.requiredData: valid names, normalization and repeated-letter counts
games.notes: Verified source daily name and whole-field dictionary validation, Normal/Easy difficulty, six guesses with repeated guesses allowed, saved partial input and finished results, source player examples and one-time win credit. Separate practice Wordle remains replayable.

games.title: Nations XI
games.mechanic: Build an XI from eleven different countries.
games.notes: Archived mode-specific membership and position pools; five formations, saved XI, Undo and assisted connections. Source roster cutoff is unpublished.

games.title: Guess the Footballer
games.mechanic: Ask yes/no profile questions before guessing a player.
games.requiredData: scoped club, nation, league, position, age profiles
games.notes: Ten source-scoped yes/no questions across eight topics, numeric comparisons, three guesses, verified player/portrait namespace crosswalks, visual options, saved history and idempotent win credit.

games.title: Legends XI
games.mechanic: Build a nationalities XI using legendary players.
games.requiredData: legend pool, country and position eligibility
games.notes: Archived mode-specific membership and position pools; five formations, saved XI, Undo and assisted connections. Source roster cutoff is unpublished. Excludes source records marked active; unmarked records are not a live retirement check.

games.title: America XI
games.mechanic: Build an XI from eleven different South American clubs.
games.requiredData: regional club membership and position eligibility
games.notes: Archived mode-specific membership and position pools; five formations, saved XI, Undo and assisted connections. Source roster cutoff is unpublished.
